newsitem.title: USA: Ammonia leak interrupts American Airlines flight.
newsitem.headline: Ammonia leak interrupts American Airlines flight.

text.p: An ammonia leak on board an American Airlines flight forced the pilot to make an emergency landing in St. Louis Saturday, but no one was injured, officials said.

Airline spokesman Al Comeaux said the ammonia was inside a passenger's carry-on luggage and began leaking during a flight from Dallas-Fort Worth airport to Chicago O'Hare with 105 passengers and five crew members on board.

"There were people getting somewhat teary-eyed and the pilot decided it was best to land in St. Louis, along the way," Comeaux said. "Once the plane landed it was determined a passenger had carried some ammonia on board and that it had leaked."
Comeaux said the plane landed without problems and continued its journey after ground crews cleaned up the leak in St. Louis.
